mechanism: Both agents increase dopaminergic activity through different mechanisms (ropinirole as D2/D3 agonist; methylphenidate as dopamine reuptake inhibitor), creating potential for additive dopaminergic effects and cardiovascular stimulation.
action: Monitor for excessive dopaminergic symptoms (dyskinesias, psychosis, impulse control disorders) and cardiovascular effects (hypertension, tachycardia, arrhythmias); consider dose adjustment or alternative to methylphenidate if symptoms emerge.
